Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Cross-border payments are available at least partially through regional and international rails (e.g., mobile money remittances and card networks); however, Guinea’s SPI cross-border linkage to PAPSS is described as a future integration ambition rather than confirmed live cross-border instant payments ([TransFi](https://www.transfi.com/blog/guineas-payment-rails-how-they-work---gim-uemoa-mobile-money-cross-border-transfers);[Ecofin Agency](https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-finances/2112-51590-guinea-readies-instant-payment-system-to-speed-transactions-and-cut-cash-use)).

Definition: Whether the system enables consumer payments to merchants and businesses for goods and services, including retail purchases, bill payments, e-commerce, and subscription services.
Comments: Merchant payments (P2B) are supported: Guinea’s SPI project explicitly targets support for “merchant payments” alongside personal transfers, and mobile money services in Guinea support bill payments and everyday purchases ([We are Tech](https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/guinea-central-bank-starts-work-on-instant-payment-system);[TransFi](https://www.transfi.com/blog/guineas-payment-rails-how-they-work---gim-uemoa-mobile-money-cross-border-transfers)).

Definition: Whether the instant payment system supports direct person-to-person transfer of funds between individuals for informal transactions, remittances, and interpersonal value transfers.
Comments: P2P is available via mobile money services in Guinea (e.g., Orange Money provides transfers), and Guinea’s planned SPI aims to enable real-time transfers between bank accounts and mobile wallets ([TransFi](https://www.transfi.com/blog/guineas-payment-rails-how-they-work---gim-uemoa-mobile-money-cross-border-transfers);[We are Tech](https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/guinea-central-bank-starts-work-on-instant-payment-system)).

Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Guinea’s central bank (Banque Centrale de la République de Guinée, BCRG) launched work on an “instant payment system (SPI)” at a workshop opened 18 Dec 2025; the system is intended to enable real-time transfers 24/7 across banks and mobile wallets and is being built on Mojaloop open-source technology, but the operational timeline was not yet specified—indicating it is under development rather than fully deployed ([We are Tech](https://www.wearetech.africa/en/fils-uk/news/tech/guinea-central-bank-starts-work-on-instant-payment-system);[OSIRIS](https://www.osiris.sn/guinee-vers-la-mise-en-oeuvre-d-un-systeme-de-paiement-instantane.html)).
